test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes is formulated to mitigate gender disparity in science and engineering research funding in various Science & Technology programs in Indian academic institutions and R&D laboratories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SERB-POWER.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SERB - POWER ** is the **Promoting Opportunities For Women in Exploratory Research.**
 
• This program is formulated **to mitigate gender disparity in science and engineering research funding in various S&T programs in Indian academic institutions and R&D Laboratories.**
 
• SERB - POWER is specially designed **to provide structured effort toward enhanced diversity in research to ensure equal access and weighted opportunities for Indian women scientists engaged in research and development activities.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ​**The SERB-Core Research Grant(CRG) Platform** will be used to identify and support women scientists under the POWER Research Grant component. Accordingly, proposals will be received through two streams:

 
 
• Stream 1: **Direct Applications for POWER Grant(Online).**
 
• Stream 2: **Applications sourced from CRG Scheme(All PACs).**
